 Dated, this the 27th day of May, 2025
 Judgment
The petitioner's property was acquired in connection with Life Science Park of the 3 rd respondent Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation.
The petitioner received compensation under protest and submitted Ext.P6 reference application to the 1st respondent District Collector dated 23.09.2017 within the stipulated time.
However, no reference as sought for has been made, is the grievance espoused.

2. Having heard the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader on behalf of respondents 1 and 2 and learned Standing Counsel for the 3rd respondent, this Court directs the 1 st respondent to pass appropriate orders in Ext.P6 reference application in accordance with law, expeditiously, at any rate, within a W.P.(C.) No.15300 of 2025 2025:KER:36607 period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of the judgment.
The petitioner will produce a copy of this judgment before the 1st respondent for compliance.
The Writ Petition is disposed of, as above.

Sd/-
